remarks: Don't Miss this Classic Colonial on 2 Acres Near Town - Quiet Cul-de-Sac Location! Set on a serene 2-acre lot on a sought-after cul-de-sac, this lovingly maintained 4-bedroom, 3-bath Classic Colonial offers timeless charm, abundant space, and unbeatable convenience just minutes from town. Inside, you'll find hardwood floors throughout, complemented by elegant granite flooring in the entrance/foyer, kitchen, and dining room-adding a touch of luxury to these central gathering spaces. The gracious formal living room, elegant dining room, and warm, inviting family room are perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The well-appointed kitchen opens to a screened porch that overlooks a flat, level backyard enclosed by long stone walls-providing exceptional privacy and a beautiful setting for outdoor living. There's also plenty of room to add a pool, making this backyard a true oasis with endless possibilities. A dedicated office and a cozy library provide flexible work-from-home options. The spacious bonus room over the 3-car garage is ready to be finished to suit your needs - adding 769 square feet of finished space, increasing the total to 4,898. The full basement offers even more potential for expansion or storage. Other highlights include a whole-house generator, impressive curb appeal, and classic colonial detailing throughout. This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready home with space to grow, custom built by the original and sole owner - in a highly desirable location.
